page_title: ATM 0-0 ESP | Atletico Madrid v Espanyol 28/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+8' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) has a goal ruled out for offside!
90+6' The ball is laid off to Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the middle of the goal and forces Joan Garcia to make a decent save.
90+4' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
90+2' The corner from Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) is hurriedly cleared.
90+2' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Atl. Madrid force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+1' Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) decides to have a direct shot at goal from the free kick, but the ball goes high over the top of the crossbar.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
89' Close! Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jofre (Espanyol) replaces Alvaro Aguado.
84' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
82' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) gets booked for the first time in this match.
76' A cooling break is underway.
74' A dangerous towering header by Alex Kral (Espanyol) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score.
74' Espanyol win a corner.
73' The substitution has been made. Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid) has replaced Alexander Sorloth.
70' Jan Oblak was forced into action to thwart Walid Cheddira (Espanyol). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the right post but couldn't beat the keeper.
68' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
67' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar.
66' Manolo Gonzalez prepares a substitution. Jose Gragera is replaced by Pol Lozano (Espanyol).
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sergi Gomez (Espanyol) comes onto the pitch so that Marash Kumbulla can be given a rest.
64' The game has come to an end for Alejo Veliz. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Walid Cheddira (Espanyol).
64' Manolo Gonzalez decides to make a substitution. Carlos Romero will be replaced by Brian Olivan (Espanyol).

63' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Joan Garcia dived superbly to block a header by Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) from around the penalty spot. His effort was directed straight towards the roof of the net, but Joan Garcia pulled off a remarkable save!
62' Atl. Madrid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
62' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rodrigo de Paul.
60' The referee blows his whistle as Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) was too aggressive in his challenge.
58' The goal by Atl. Madrid won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
56' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Atl. Madrid players aren’t happy.
55' Goal! Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) has the simplest of tasks to roll the ball into an empty net from close range after a rebound left the keeper stranded. 1:0.
55' Marash Kumbulla (Espanyol) is booked for saying more than Ricardo De Burgos was willing to tolerate.
54' That's a well-taken pass by Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
51' Alvaro Aguado (Espanyol) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post.
49' The resulting set piece from Atl. Madrid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
48' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Atl. Madrid will have a corner.
46' Half-time substitution. Diego Simeone decided to make a change. Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) is replaced by Marcos Llorente.
46' Diego Simeone has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Pablo Barrios comes on the pitch for Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid).
46' Half-time substitution. Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) will not participate anymore and Antoine Griezmann is coming on.
46' The whistle blows and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea starts the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+1' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the right post. His effort, however, is blocked by Joan Garcia, who pulls off a stunning save!
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Espanyol.
44' Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) is flagged for offside.
42' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner which is cleared.
41' The current number of shots on goal is 4:0.
36' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) makes a rough challenge and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows for a foul after Alejo Veliz (Espanyol) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
33' Close! Alvaro Aguado (Espanyol) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot narrowly over the bar.
31' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
27' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the roof of the net, but Joan Garcia is prepared and leaps to thwart him.
25' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.
23' Espanyol have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
21' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
21' Atl. Madrid take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

20' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball is out of play. Atl. Madrid win a corner kick.
18' Fernando Calero (Espanyol) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea saw the whole situation.
16' The corner is swung in but Espanyol can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

16' Koke (Atl. Madrid) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Atl. Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
15' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his strike flies just a few inches over the bar.
15' The referee blows his whistle, Atl. Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
15' Javi Puado (Espanyol) commits a rough challenge and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle for a foul.
13' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) who sends his header well wide of the right post.
12' Axel Witsel (Atl. Madrid) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
11' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atl. Madrid comes to nothing.
11' Koke (Atl. Madrid) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. The referee signals a corner kick to Atl. Madrid.
10' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
8' Good chance! Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!

6' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Joan Garcia makes a great save to stop his effort.

6' That's unlucky! Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar.
5' A quickly taken corner by Atl. Madrid.
5' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid). The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Atl. Madrid.
2' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid). Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Atl. Madrid will take the kick-off.
Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea will referee today's match.
